title: Implementation Status & Results Report: CAMEROON Education Reform Support Project (P160926), Seq No: 14
why_not: Describes the census only: Pillar 6 'Integrated EMIS' is measured by the integrated statistical yearbook (5th being validated) and a PAREC-UNESCO MoU to decentralise the EMIS to the 10 regions for MINEDUB and MINESEC; no learner record, no school entry during the year, no statement that records are on paper.
